AuditPlatform.compositionModelDesc: Traditional calculation uses only a single standard recipe: 100 cups of Pearl Milk Tea = 22L of tea. However, customer orders include different combinations: 0 toppings, 1 topping, 2 toppings, 3 toppings. When toppings exceed 2 types, the liquid space in the cup is displaced by the toppings (about 40-50ml), but after shaking, staff often top up tea or fresh milk to the rim to prevent leaks. Therefore, the "sales mix" must go through this model's compensation adjustment to arrive at a truly objective "theoretical consumption."

CsHelp.pageDesc: Follow the steps in order to complete your entire customer service setup. No tech experience needed — use "Have someone set it up for me" anytime you need help.
CsHelp.sec1Title: ① Channel Binding (LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram / Zalo)
CsHelp.sec1Summary: Let customers message you on LINE, WhatsApp, etc. so the AI agent can automatically receive and reply. This is the top-priority setup — without a bound channel, the AI agent cannot receive customer messages.
CsHelp.sec1Step1: LINE OA: Log in to the LINE Developers Console → create a Messaging API channel → paste the Channel Access Token and Channel Secret on the "Channel Binding" page → paste the system-shown Webhook URL back into the LINE admin console, enable "Use webhook", and disable "Auto-reply messages"
CsHelp.sec1Step2: WhatsApp Business: Create a WhatsApp product on Meta for Developers → enter the Phone Number ID and Access Token → set a custom Verify Token (any alphanumeric string, must match on both sides) → paste the Webhook URL and Verify Token into the Meta admin console
CsHelp.sec1Step3: Telegram: Chat with @BotFather to create a bot, get the token, and paste it in — the system will auto-register the webhook, no manual setup needed
CsHelp.sec1Step4: Zalo OA: Get the OA Access Token from the Zalo for Business console and paste it in, then paste the Webhook URL into the Zalo admin console
CsHelp.sec1Step5: Not sure how to do this? Just click "Not sure how to set up? Have someone help me" and leave your contact info — we'll take care of it
CsHelp.sec1FaqQ1: I bound the channel but I'm not receiving customer messages?
CsHelp.sec1FaqA1: First confirm the platform's admin console shows the webhook as bound/verified, then check that auto-reply is disabled (LINE requires manual disabling, otherwise it conflicts with the AI).
CsHelp.sec1FaqQ2: Do I have to fill in the token myself?
CsHelp.sec1FaqA2: No — this step is harder for first-time computer users. We recommend using "Have someone help me" so we can do it for you.
CsHelp.sec2Title: ② Platform Status in the CS System
CsHelp.sec2Summary: This is the same data as "Channel Binding," just viewed from a different place. You can see whether each platform is currently "Connected" or "Not Set Up," and run connection diagnostics or send a test message for Telegram to confirm it's working.
CsHelp.sec2Step1: Go to the "Platforms" tab and check the top-right corner of each platform card for "Connected" or "Not Set Up"
CsHelp.sec2Step2: Telegram only: Click "View Error Status" to check if the webhook is working and the bot token is valid; click "Send" to send a test message to a specified Chat ID and confirm the bot can actually reply
CsHelp.sec2Step3: If the status stays stuck on "Not Set Up," go back to ① "Channel Binding" and recheck that the token was saved correctly
CsHelp.sec3Title: ③ AI Settings (System Prompt / Quoting Flow / VIP / Promotions)
CsHelp.sec3Summary: This determines "how the AI agent talks" and "what to do in different situations" — the most core setting in the whole system, but also the easiest to confuse. Remember: "the AI's personality" goes here, "specific data" goes in the "Knowledge Base" tab.
CsHelp.sec3Step1: Click "Apply Template" first to quickly apply preset wording for your industry (homestay/e-commerce/food service...) instead of starting from scratch
CsHelp.sec3Step2: System prompt: defines the AI's role and tone, e.g. "You are customer service for a homestay, please be friendly and polite" — don't paste FAQs or prices here, those belong in the "Knowledge Base"
CsHelp.sec3Step3: AI routing: low/medium-risk questions go to Gemini (fast, cheap); returns/complaints/legal issues auto-escalate to Claude (more careful). Usually no need to change this unless you want more questions escalated
CsHelp.sec3Step4: Quoting flow: once enabled, the AI automatically detects when a customer is asking about price, gradually collects booking/purchase info, and applies the "Pricing Calculator" to compute the correct amount
CsHelp.sec3Step5: Promotions & gifts: enter discounts or gifts the AI can proactively offer when a customer hesitates or complains about price — the AI only mentions one at a time, never dumps them all at once
CsHelp.sec3Step6: VIP keywords: enter regular customers' names, LINE nicknames, or the last 4 digits of their phone number — matching conversations are automatically flagged "VIP Priority"
CsHelp.sec3FaqQ1: What if the AI answers prices incorrectly?
CsHelp.sec3FaqA1: Don't write prices in the "System Prompt" — set them in the "Pricing Calculator" tab instead, so the AI replies with the system-calculated number instead of guessing.
CsHelp.sec4Summary: Enter the specific information you'll be asked about: common Q&As, room/product descriptions, policy terms, etc. The AI agent looks here for answers first, and only falls back to the ③ system prompt if nothing is found.
CsHelp.sec4Step1: Paste your FAQ directly into the text box, formatted like "Q: What time is check-in? A: After 3 PM"
CsHelp.sec4Step2: You can also chat with the AI in the "Test" tab and one-click "Add to Knowledge Base" from a good reply — it will be cited directly for similar questions afterward
CsHelp.sec4Step3: The more complete the content, the lower the chance of the AI answering incorrectly — we recommend writing in the "10 most common customer questions" first
CsHelp.sec5Summary: If you already track orders, passwords, inventory, etc. in Google Sheets, you can connect it directly so the AI agent can look up answers in real time instead of manually copying into the knowledge base each time.
CsHelp.sec5Step1: Change the Google Sheets permission to "Anyone with the link can view"
CsHelp.sec5Step2: Click "Add," paste the sheet URL, and fill in the "Lookup column" (e.g. order number column name) and "Return column" (the column to reply to the customer with, e.g. room number, password)
CsHelp.sec5Step3: Set "Trigger keywords" — the sheet is only looked up when these words appear in the customer's message, e.g. "order, password, room number"
CsHelp.sec5Step4: Common uses: order/password sheet (look up room number/door lock code), order lookup sheet (check shipping/delivery status)
CsHelp.sec5FaqQ1: Why can't it find any data?
CsHelp.sec5FaqA1: The most common reason is the Google Sheets permission isn't set to "Anyone with the link can view," or the "Lookup column" name doesn't exactly match the sheet's header row (spacing must match too).
CsHelp.sec6Summary: Once your price list (room types, ticket types, weekday/weekend prices, packages, group discounts) is set up, the AI will precisely apply these numbers when quoting prices — no guessing, no math errors.
CsHelp.sec6Step1: Click "+ Booking" or "+ Itinerary" above to add an item
CsHelp.sec6Step2: Enter weekday and weekend prices (the system defaults Fri/Sat/Sun as weekend, others as weekday); you can also mark national holidays separately
CsHelp.sec6Step3: If you offer group or multi-night discounts, fill in the "Group Discount" rules
CsHelp.sec6Step4: After setup, go to the "Test" tab and enter something like "Two adults this weekend, how much for room XX?" to verify the calculated amount is correct
CsHelp.sec7Summary: Before going live, pretend to be a customer here and chat with the AI to confirm all the settings from ①–⑥ are working and the AI replies the way you expect.
CsHelp.sec7Step1: Type directly in the input box, simulating questions a customer might ask
CsHelp.sec7Step2: Confirm the AI correctly replies with knowledge base content, quotes prices correctly, and auto-escalates complaint-type issues
CsHelp.sec7Step3: If you like a particular reply, click "Add to Knowledge Base" to make it the standard answer going forward
CsHelp.sec8Summary: See how many questions the AI agent actually answered each day, which are the most common questions, and how fast responses are — helping you understand your CS status and find gaps in the knowledge base.
CsHelp.sec9Summary: When a customer requests human assistance, or the AI determines escalation is needed, the system creates a ticket you can track here (pending/in progress/resolved/closed).
CsHelp.sec10Summary: Bring all conversations from LINE, WhatsApp, Telegram, and other platforms together in one screen — reply to customers directly and switch between "AI auto-reply" and "human takeover" anytime. Can also be installed as a phone app for easy access.

CsWorkspace.negotiationToolkitDesc: When a customer hesitates over price, the AI may offer either a discount or a gift (one or the other, never both). CsWorkspace.helpPricingTitle: How does the pricing calculator work?
CsWorkspace.helpPricingBody: Enter weekday/weekend prices and group discounts for each room type or ticket, and the AI will apply these exact numbers when quoting prices — never a guess. Once set up, verify it on the "Test" tab by asking for a quote.

CsWorkspace.roomPricingRulesTitle: How room pricing and occupancy limits work:
CsWorkspace.roomPricingRule1: Base prices are always for double occupancy: the weekday, weekend and holiday prices in the table are all [double-occupancy prices] (baseline 2 people).
CsWorkspace.roomPricingRule2: Max occupancy (cap): setting it to 2 means "no extra person/no extra bed allowed"; setting it to 3–4 means "up to 3–4 people/an extra bed can be added".
CsWorkspace.roomPricingRule3: 2nd-night discounts, extra-child fees, or complex tiered rules: the "extra person fee" column above is just a baseline reference (leave it 0 if there's no fixed value); if you spell out the exact steps for 2nd-night pricing, child vs. extra-bed fees etc. in "Check-in Notes" below, the AI will strictly follow those detailed steps first when quoting a price!
